shopperQuestions: Is a heated throw 50x60 inches or a bed-size electric blanket?
How many heat settings are actually offered?
When does it automatically shut off: 3, 4 or 8 hours?
Does it have a separate preheat mode?
Can the controller be detached before laundering?
Which merchant actually sells/ships it and what is the current final delivered price?
Has the exact model been subject to CPSC safety action?

safety.caution: Electric heated blankets are electrical products. Match the exact model, review certification claim and manual, check CPSC recalls, and inspect cords/controller; stop use for heat damage or frayed wiring. Do not fold or cover an operating blanket against manufacturer instructions.
safety.warningBrand: Melinora electric heated blankets (unrelated item): CPSC urged stop use July 16, 2026 due to fire/burn hazard. Do not recommend or confuse with listed brands.
